plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Criminal Justice - Law Enforcement BA/BS 'Graduation Plan (traditional)' (the non-academy track; the program also publishes a 'Graduation Plan (POST)', transcribed separately). Semester totals as printed: 15 x 8 = 120, matching the printed 'Total Hours 120'. Course titles verified against the official 2025-2026 Criminology Minor program text: CJ 1010 Introduction to Criminal Justice; CJ 1330 Criminal Law; CJ 1340 Criminal Investigation; CJ 1390 Police Field Operations; CJ 3270 Criminology; CJ 3300 Research Methods in Criminology and Criminal Justice; SOC 3111 Research Methods; CJ 3400 Drugs and Crime; CJ 3450 Community Policing; CJ 3655 Mock Trial; CJ 4150 Criminal Justice Reform; CJ 4200 Ethical Issues in Criminal Justice; CJ 4900 Current Issues in Criminal Justice; ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN). 'PSY 1010 or SOC 1010' choice: PSY 1010 General Psychology (SS, GC) or SOC 1010 (title not shown in the plan). 'PHIL 2050', 'COMM 2110', 'ENGL 2100', 'COMM 4500' are choice placeholders (credits as printed); titles not shown in the graduation plan — see the 2025-2026 catalog course descriptions. 'CJ Emphasis Elective' slots (numbered 1-9) are choice placeholders for emphasis courses — see the program text for the eligible list. Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
